title: Use Seedance 2.0 mini without an image prompt to generate a dark fantasy…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 mini without an image prompt to generate a dark fantasy creature from text only.  
Use Seedance 2.0 mini instead of the full model to reduce credit usage when you’re on a budget.
